Emily Simmons is a UFS scientist and one of the playable characters in Action Taimanin.

She researches Taimanin to find a civilian use of their powers.

Personality
Emily is a polite, upbeat and has a passionate attitude. She can feel insulted if her abilities are questioned for being nerdish, though remains friendly and open about it. Emily has a competitive side to her, but in games uses her high intelligence and ingenuity to break/bend in such an open way that it is almost naive. On top of her high intelligent, she also has photographic memory and is able to multitask to a crazy degree.

Unlike, others, Emily handles demon bug or rather disguising things easier being more interested in research.

Deeply believing in the power of science, she hopes to create a theory about Taimanin powers for the good of everybody in the world, even those that can't use Taima Particles. Her fascination with Taimanin, like Asagi, border on love by an outsider.

Appearance
She is a glassing wearing woman with a large bust, green eyes and long blond hair.

Wears a white and black battle suit, which connects also to her Flight Suit.



History
Background
A normal Human researcher, with access to an Exoskeleton and Drone Orbiters.

One of her main fields of research are Taimanin and how Taima Particles could help the wider public.

Timeline RPGX
Emily worked for the UFS at Kotrara, researching the regenerating corpse copy of Momochi Toyo and the zombie plague. Her team was overrun by the Creature-Zombies, and her Drone Orbiter was shortly hacked by an unknown enemy.

Trying to flee, she met up with Fuuma Kotaro's Taimanin Task Force, which was sent in by their UFS contact James McGahren. Emily notes that if James send them in, it wasn't a rescue mission at that point and more about recovering bodies. Supporting the team of Taimanins, she showed them the way to the corpse of Toyo. Encountering Noah Brown, the group followed the demon to a mansion and fought against Astaroth.

Emily remained in the Taimanin Task Force afterward in the hope to study Igawa Asagi and as part of the anti-Nomad faction of the UFS. Emily mentioned on multiple occasions towards the Masked Taimanin of the DSO, that a possible traitor exists somewhere, or that her equipment was manipulated on Kotrara. Since then, Emily has become a full member of the Task Force and supported her on the battlefield and with her knowledge, specially creating combat suits or new weapons.
